name: Powers of Eldritch
source:
"Powers of Eldritch" Is a Lovecraftian novel filled with mystery and magic, you play as a main protagonist who is suddenly wrapped in chaos, sex and romance. 

The story begins with a troubled young person (you), who through series of strange visions and dreadful encounters acquires not only weird and mighty abilites but grave responsibilities and discovers new ways of expressing his sexuality.
